en:
<CLT=cltMIND>This doesn't look like a normal school pool...
more like a pool at a resort.

<CLT=cltMIND>There isn't that much water in it...
Aren't pools usually filled up more?

Whoooa! I've always dreamed of swimming
in a fancy pool like some big-shot celebrity!
Too bad I don't know how to swim.

<CLT=cltMIND>...Then I suppose that dream
is pretty far away.

It's not necessarily a dream of mine... But
swimming with everyone does sound fun.
If I tried to swim, I would just sink.
<CLT=cltMIND>...And that one is even farther.

I wonder if the day will ever come when
I can swim with everyone...
Keebo! I was wondering...

If you fell off a boat and sank to the
bottom...

...would you be stuck living under the sea,
beneath a rock or in a pineapple!?
What...?

No, I believe that before you'd get too deep,
your body would be crushed by the pressure...

Please don't say such scary things, both
of you! Or I'll never set foot on a boat!

If I ever get the chance to ride a boat, I will
wear a state-of-the-art floatation device.

If there's a fancy pool here, then there must
be swimsuits here, too!
Huh? Are you positive?

Of course! There'd be no point having
this pool here otherwise!
Well, I suppose that's true, but...

So where are the swimsuits? I only saw
extra school uniforms back at the dorm.

<CLT=cltMIND>That's true, all the closets seem
to contain is spare uniforms...

If there were any swimsuits...
I suppose they'd be in the warehouse.

H-How scandalous! They're in a place that
degenerate males have easy access to!
I...don't really think that's a problem...
Oh, I get it!

Degenerates only care about used swimsuits,
or ones that girls are wearing, don't they!?

If that's the case, then the swimsuits in the
warehouse are definitely safe!

I wonder if they are in the warehouse though.
I should look for them later.
<CLT=cltMIND>But, Tenko...you can't swim...
<CLT=cltMIND>There's still something bothering me...
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?
<CLT=cltMIND>There's still something bothering me...
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's so clunky...
I wonder if that's just what Monokuma likes.

<CLT=cltMIND>This doesn't look like a normal school pool...
more like a pool at a resort.
<CLT=cltMIND>There isn't that much water in it...

<CLT=cltMIND>This doesn't look like a normal school pool...
more like a pool at a resort.

<CLT=cltMIND>The pool is deep, but it isn't filled
up all the way. Still, plenty of water to swim in.
This looks like...a storage room?

I peeked inside and discovered all manner
of pool supplies in here.

It is fully stocked with kickboards, water polo
balls, and even sturdy rubber inner tubes.

Perhaps I can float in water if I inflate them
and attach them all over my body.

Ah, I think you would look like that
tire company's mascot...

<CLT=cltMIND>This is a storage room.
There's a bunch of pool equipment inside...

<CLT=cltMIND>That window must be the gym's window.
It looks like the one that was in the gym.

<CLT=cltMIND>I suppose that means the gym
and the pool area are connected.

It's pretty standard for a school to have the
gym and the pool area near each other.

But I think the pool can be moved to a much
larger area!

There's plenty of land in the courtyard!
What about there!?
I...don't know?

<CLT=cltMIND>That window must be the gym's window.
It looks like the one that was in the gym.

<CLT=cltMIND>I suppose that means the gym
and the pool area are connected.

There's so much unused land in the
courtyard...

Why did they build the pool here!?
What's up with that!?
Uh, I...still don't know?

<CLT=cltMIND>This window...must be one
of the school building's.

<CLT=cltMIND>I remember all of the windows being
sealed off, but...

<CLT=cltMIND>This window in particular looks like a
normal window. What room does it belong to?

Grrrrr! Anyone could peep through that
window!
Peep? Who would do that?

I heard degenerate males get more turned on by
girls in swimsuits than by girls who are naked!

And they go bonkers over the bloomers we wear
over our panties that we wear over our privates!

What are girls supposed to do against the
filthy desires of degenerate males!?
Ah, I think you may be...overreacting a little...

Oh, Keebo! Are you a degenerate male or a girl!?
Which is it!?

Good question... I've honestly never thought
about it before.
Really? How interesting...

<CLT=cltMIND>I suppose I did just assume he
was a...he. But Keebo is a robot, so...

<CLT=cltMIND>This window...must be one
of the school building's.

<CLT=cltMIND>I remember all of the windows being
sealed off, but...

<CLT=cltMIND>This window in particular looks like a
normal window. What room does it belong to?

Grrrrr! You look pretty eager to check
the window...
You're thinking about peeping, aren't you!?
N-No! I would never do anything like that!
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a large diving board.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is also something you would
find at a resort...

<CLT=cltMIND>Some pool rules are posted here.
There's one that I find peculiar...
So swimming is prohibited at nighttime...?

That's right. No one's allowed to swim
during nighttime.

It'd be terrible if someone died due to an
unfortunate nighttime swimming accident.
We need youse to die in the killing game!

You can visit the pool at nighttime, but even
touching the water is against the rules.

Oh...I guess I'll add it to the existing
regulations, just in case.
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>School regulations have been updated.

Ah, anyway, why is the pool's water level
so low? It's barely enough to swim—

What the hell are you sayin'!? Ya got gapin'
holes instead of eyes or somethin'!?

There's enough water to swim. It only looks
shallow because the pool is so deep.

And someone would be more likely to
drown if we filled it up all the way.
So that's that!

<CLT=cltMIND>...They put a lot of thought
into some strange things.
...WONDERFUL-EXPLANATION-EVERYONE.

...What? Really? Oh I'm so happy to hear
you say that.

Did you forget that he killed Monokid!
You should hate his guts!
Screw Monokid! I always hated him!

He was violent, vulgar, rude to shop clerks,
and had a soft spot for abandoned kitties!
Why'd that sound like praise near the end?

<CLT=cltMIND>...Anyway, no swimming at nighttime.
That's okay, I wasn't planning on swimming...

<CLT=cltMIND>There are also some specifications
written here...

<CLT=cltMIND>The pool is 82 feet in length
and is 39 feet wide...

<CLT=cltMIND>The poolside is 13 feet on each end,
and the left and right sides are 8 feet each...

<CLT=cltMIND>Some pool rules are posted here.
There's one that I find peculiar...

Swimming is prohibited during nighttime.
Well, I don't really want to swim anyway.

<CLT=cltMIND>There are also some specifications
written here...

<CLT=cltMIND>The pool is 82 feet in length
and is 39 feet wide...

<CLT=cltMIND>The poolside is 13 feet on each end,
and the left and right sides are 8 feet each...

<CLT=cltMIND>I wish I had such detailed answers
to my more important questions...
